senses.gloss: मिश् vt. or vi. 1P (pres. मेशति) 1. To make a sound; 2. to provoke.
मिष् (I) vt. 1P (pres. मेषति) To sprinkle, to wet.

मिष् (II) vt. 6P (pres. मिषति) 1. To rival, to emulate, to contend with; 2. to look at, to look on, जातवेदोमुखान्मायी मिषतागाच्छिनति K.S.ii.46.With उद्-, 1. to open the eyes, उन्मिषन्निमिषन्नपि Bg.v.8, K.S.iv.2; 2. to blossom; 3. to shine, to look splendid.With नि-, to shut the eyes, Bg.v.8.
मिश्र् vt. 10U (pres. मिश्रयति-ते) To combine, to unite, to mingle, to add, न मिश्रयति लोचने सहसितं न संभाषते Bh.V.ii.140.
मिश्र (I) a. (f. श्रा) 1. Mixed, mingled, combined, R.xvi.32; 2. diverge, manifold; 3. intertwined.
मिश्र (II) m. 1. A kind of elephant; 2. a title of respect affixed to the names of scholars and great men, e.g. कृष्णमिश्र, मित्रमिश्र.
मिश्र (III) n. 1. A mixture; 2. a kind of radish.
मिश्र (I) a. (f. श्रा) 1. Mixed, mingled, combined, R.xvi.32; 2. diverge, manifold; 3. intertwined.
मिश्र-ज m. a mule.
मिश्र-वर्ण n. a kind of aloe-wood.
मिश्र-शब्द m. a mule.
मिश्रक (I) m. An adulterator of articles of commerce.
मिश्रक (II) n. A kind of salt.
मिश्रण n. Mixing, combining.
मिश्रित a. (f. ता) 1. Mixed, united; 2. respectable.
मिश्रित a. (f. ता) 1. Mixed, united; 2. respectable.
मिष (I) m. Rivalry, emulation.
मिष (II) n. Pretext, false appearance, trick, fraud; (the word is employed in this sense to indicate an Utprekshā), वदने विनिवेशिता भुजंगी पिशुनानां रसनामिषेण धात्रा Bh.V.i.111.
मिष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Sweet; 2. dainty, savoury; 3. moistened.
मिष्ट (II) n. A sweetmeat.
मिष्ट (I) a. (f. ष्टा) 1. Sweet; 2. dainty, savoury; 3. moistened.
